doc.citation: Hashemi, H., Sajjadi, F. and Bahrami Hesari, N. 2019. Palynostratigraphy and palaeoecology of the Niur Formation, Tikdar section, northwest of Kerman, Central Iran. Journal of Stratigraphy and Sedimentology Researches 35(1), 1–22.
doc.language: Persian with English abstract and summary
doc.comment: Two trilete-spore taxa are named in Plate 3; neither is assigned to an individual sample. The Llandovery age rests on marine palynomorphs. The printed concatenation in Apiculatasporitessp. is preserved.

items.locality: Tikdar village, 8 km northeast of Chatrud, northwest of Kerman, Central Iran
items.depth_or_level: 90 m palyniferous interval between the basal 65 m and upper 45 m barren intervals of the 200 m formation
items.age_basis_detail: Acritarchs Eupoikilofusa striatifera and Geron amabilis, chitinozoans Spinachitina fragilis and Ancyrochitina convexa, and absence of Middle and Late Silurian index taxa.
items.setting_as_reported: marginal marine setting with mainly low sedimentation rate and relatively low oxygen level
items.notes: Marine palynomorphs dominate the diversity and abundance and are the principal biostratigraphic focus. Two spore taxa are reported; the text describes radially symmetrical forms with trilete marks and explicitly reports no monolete specimens. No cryptospore taxa are reported. Basal 65 m and upper 45 m intervals are described as barren of palynomorphs. Figure 3 charts acritarchs and chitinozoans, while Figure 5 treats spores collectively; neither supplies sample distributions for the two named spore taxa. Slides were supplied by the National Iranian Oil Company. Central Iran is the reported geographic designation; the Gondwana mapping is proposed.
items.locator: English abstract and summary, pp. 1–2; locality and coordinates, p. 4; palynofloral composition and palynostratigraphy, pp. 7–8; Figure 3, p. 9; age discussion, p. 10; Figure 5, p. 11; Plate 3, p. 21.
